title: Indomitable Resolve
overview: As Shinra and the others take a break, an alarm sounds. Soldiers interrupt Obi's report to the Fire Chief.

title: Prisoner
overview: The 8th takes action to rescue Obi. Labeled as traitors, they go on the run, then Joker appears before them.

title: Incarnation of Flame
overview: Obi is trapped in Fuchu Penitentiary. Shinra and Joker arrive before Hinawa and the others. The battle begins!

title: Golden Secret
overview: The 8th struggles to find a way to counter Gold's powers. And then, someone unexpected steps up to fight.

title: Chance Meeting with an Arch-Enemy
overview: Obi writhes in pain. Burns attacks Shinra relentlessly. A Destroyer called Dragon blocks the 8th's path.

title: Beyond Prayer's End
overview: Shinra and Burns' battle rages on. A hero's feelings clash against the will of a servant of Sol. Who will win?

title: Sleeping Truth
overview: The 8th faces dire danger with no escape. Then, a familiar figure appears, calling himself—Moonlite Mask?!

title: Holy Mother of Darkness / The Knight-King's Great Adventure
overview: As Hibana and the others continue their investigation at St. Raffles Convent, someone unexpected appears.

title: Holy Sword, Resurrected
overview: Arthur leads the party into unexpected territory in the search for metal to reforge Excalibur.

title: Advent
overview: After a glimpse via an Adolla Link, Sho decides to see his brother one more time before the Great Cataclysm.

title: The Great Kaiju Battlefront
overview: The Great Cataclysm is set in motion. A giant pillar appears in the Pacific. Shinra asks to be sent in, but...

title: The Madness of the Distant Past
overview: Faerie captures an unconscious Shinra. Sho appears and attacks. Shinra gets advice from a surprising source.
